answers.d01: 似然与概率方向相反：概率是「参数给定，问数据」；似然是「数据已看到，反过来评价参数」——哪个参数能让这批数据最不意外。抛正面概率为θ的硬币10次，得7次正面：P(7正|θ)=C(10,7)·θ⁷·(1−θ)³。代入θ=0.5约0.117，θ=0.7约0.267；数据固定，θ=0.7让这批数据「产量」更高，就说它似然更大。注意似然不是θ的概率，对θ积分不为1。后验概率回答的是另一问：「看到7正之后，θ的可信度如何」——用贝叶斯公式，后验 ∝ 先验 × 似然，再归一。似然是桥梁，把这次数据的信息注入你对参数的信念；先验是看数据前的判断。条件变化：数据从10次增到1000次，似然会集中在真实θ附近。有限数据只能让某些θ更受支持，不能证实某一个。
answers.d02: Two classes can both average 70, yet one is clustered near 70 and the other scattered from 40 to 100. Variance measures that spread. Population variance: take each value's distance from the mean, square it, average the squares. Squaring serves two purposes: misses above and below count positively instead of cancelling to zero, and large misses get extra weight. Example: {68, 70, 72}, mean 70; deviations −2, 0, 2; squares 4, 0, 4; variance = 8/3 ≈ 2.67. Replace the 72 with 90 and variance jumps to about 66.7 — one outlier dominates, because squares amplify big deviations. The result is in squared units, so √variance (the standard deviation) returns to original units: roughly 1.6 vs 8.2. We divide by N because this is the whole population; estimating from a sample uses N−1 instead. Change which group you mean, and you are computing a different quantity.
answers.d03: 正反馈是输出沿同方向回到输入的回路：变化每绕一圈就被加强一圈。麦克风对着音箱，声音被拾音、放大、再放出、更响，几秒内变成啸叫——每一轮都以上一轮加强后的音量为起点，只要环路增益大于1，扰动就逐轮放大。但「正」只指方向相同，不是评价好坏：学习顺利→更有信心→更投入是好的正反馈；银行恐慌时挤兑→银行更可能倒→更多人挤兑是坏的正反馈。放大也不是无限：音量最终被功放顶住，挤兑止于存款上限。改变一个条件：把环路增益降到1以下（话筒背对音箱），同样一次扰动每圈衰减一点，系统就稳定。判断回路时，先追出输出怎样影响输入、同向还是反向，再看增益大小。
answers.d04: You have one free afternoon: nap, study for Friday's exam, or take a gig paying 200 yuan. Whatever you pick, you give up the others — and opportunity cost is the value of the single best one you gave up, not all of them added together. Choose the gig: your opportunity cost is the exam prep, if that was your next-best option; the nap does not add to it, because you could only have done one of them anyway. Cost here is not only money — lost rest or lost study time counts too, valued by what it was worth to you. Change one condition: if the exam is tomorrow morning, studying jumps to the top, so the gig's opportunity cost rises and may flip your decision — same gig, same pay, different cost. What does not count: options already gone. Only the real alternatives ahead of you set the price of a choice.
answers.d05: 某病患病率1%：1000人中约10个患者。检测灵敏度99%（患者几乎都测出阳性），健康人也有5%被误报。有人拿到阳性报告，他真患病的概率是多少？直觉说99%，贝叶斯公式给出另一答案。1000人中：患者约9.9人阳性；990个健康人约49.5人误报。阳性共约59.4人，其中真患病的9.9/59.4≈17%。公式：P(病|阳)=P(阳|病)P(病)÷[P(阳|病)P(病)+P(阳|无病)P(无病)]，分子是患病且阳性的部分，分母是全部阳性来源。离99%这么远的原因：健康人基数大，5%的误报也人数众多——这是基础率在起作用。条件变化：在患病率10%的高危人群筛查，同一个检测的阳性预测大幅上升；误报率降一半，结果也明显改善。关键区分：P(阳|病)是检测灵敏度，回答「有病的人多大比例被测出」；P(病|阳)才是拿到报告后的患病概率，方向不能反。
answers.d06: A cache is a fast local copy of data that is slow to fetch again — your app might cache a product page so it need not query the database for every visitor. Invalidation is the rule deciding when that copy is stale and must be discarded. The problem: after the price changes in the database, the cache still serves the old page, and nothing tells the cache automatically — the copy cannot sense edits to the original. That is why cache invalidation is famously hard. Common answers: a TTL expires each entry after, say, 60 seconds — simple, but users can see up to a minute of old prices; or the write path deletes or updates the cached key whenever the database changes — fresher, but every write now has two steps to keep consistent. Change the data to something rarely edited and a TTL alone is fine; make it a live stock count and you need write-path invalidation.
answers.d07: 同涨同跌不等于谁导致谁。冰淇淋销量与溺水人数每年同步上升，相关很强，但吃冰淇淋不会让人溺水——真正原因是气温：天热既让人买冰淇淋，也让人下水，这叫混杂因素。区分可走三步。先问机制：冰淇淋如何导致溺水？讲不通。再控制混杂：把数据按气温分层，同一温度下两者的相关基本消失，说明相关是气温带来的。最有力的手段是随机对照：随机分组把气温等混杂摊平到两组，剩下的差异才指向处理本身。条件变化：只看冬天数据，相关消失，说明「夏天」是关键前提；若控制气温后相关仍在，因果嫌疑才上升。反过来也要小心：因果不一定表现成相关——样本范围受限或效应抵消都可能掩盖它，所以没测到相关也不能直接排除因果。相关是线索，因果要靠机制加控制来支撑。
answers.d08: Compound growth means gains earn gains: each period's increase is a fixed percentage of a total that already contains earlier gains. Put 10,000 yuan at 10% a year — year one earns 1,000, year two earns 1,100 because the interest itself now earns interest. After 10 years you have about 25,900, not the 20,000 simple interest gives. The starting amount matters because growth is multiplicative: the same rate over the same years scales whatever base it gets, so 100,000 at the same 10% ends ten times larger at every date. It is also why early money counts most — each yuan added to the base rides every later round of gains. Change one condition: a negative return compounds downward the same way, and withdrawals shrink the base. Limit: a projected rate must actually hold; compounding guarantees arithmetic, not returns.
answers.v01: 过拟合是模型把训练数据「背下来」而非学会规律，于是在没见过的数据上表现变差。数据里规律和噪声混在一起，模型太复杂时会把噪声也当成规律拟合进去。类比：学生把历年真题每道答案背熟，模拟卷次次满分，正式考试一换数字就不会——背题代替了理解。辨认信号：训练集准确率很高，新数据上明显更低，这个差距就是过拟合；反过来训练和测试都很差叫欠拟合。对策各有代价：加数据（噪声被更多样本平均掉）、简化模型、正则化（惩罚复杂度，逼模型只留主要规律）、交叉验证（提前估计新数据上的表现）。条件变化：同一个模型，数据从100条增到10万条，可背的噪声相对变少，过拟合自然减轻；反过来一味加深模型，训练误差继续下降，新数据上的误差却先降后升。
answers.v02: Query 'jaguar' against a library where 100 documents are relevant; the engine returns 10, of which 8 are relevant. Precision = 8/10 = 80%: of what was returned, the share that is relevant — it answers 'can I trust this list?' Recall = 8/100 = 8%: of all relevant documents, the share that was found — it answers 'how much did I miss?' Same retrieved set, different denominator; that is the whole distinction. The two pull against each other: returning only the 3 surest hits raises precision but drops recall to 3%, while returning 300 loose hits raises recall as precision sinks. Which to favor depends on which error costs more: a quick-answer page wants precision (wrong links waste attention), legal discovery wants recall (missed evidence is worse). Note both ignore ranking: a perfect top result can still sit in a low-recall list.
answers.v03: 自然选择不是动物主动努力变强，而是繁殖差异对群体的筛选。拆成四步：鹿群中本来就存在随机变异——有的天生跑得快，这是随机产生，不是鹿想快就快；速度可以遗传给后代；有狼的环境里，快的鹿更少被吃掉，留下更多后代；于是下一代种群中「快」的基因比例升高，几代后种群平均速度上升。变的是群体的构成比例，不是某只鹿通过锻炼把自己变快——后天获得的体能不进入遗传。每一步都没有意图：变异随机，选择只是「谁留下更多后代」这个统计事实，方向由环境给出。条件变化：狼消失后速度优势不再，耐寒等别的性状可能被筛，种群转向另一方向；若快慢差异不影响繁殖，这个性状也不会被推动。进化没有目标、没有「更高级」的方向，只有当前环境下的比例变化。
answers.v04: An operation is idempotent if doing it once or many times with the same input leaves the same result. 'Set status to shipped' is idempotent — the second call changes nothing. 'Add 100 to the balance' is not — each call charges again. Distributed systems care because networks retry: a payment request times out, the client cannot tell whether it went through, so it resends; without idempotency the customer is charged twice. The standard tool is an idempotency key: the client attaches a unique key to the logical operation and to every retry of it; the server records the result under that key and, seeing the same key again, returns the stored response instead of executing once more. The cost is real: the server must persist keys and results and decide how long to keep them. Design rule: wherever retries are possible, make the operation idempotent or deduplicate by key.
answers.v05: 信息熵衡量一个随机来源平均有多不确定：H = −Σp·log₂p，单位是比特。它是对「意外程度」的平均——概率越小的事越意外，但出现的机会也越小。把概率从均匀挪向偏斜时，两种效应反向：小概率事件一旦出现更意外，可它更少出现。算一下就知道后者赢：两个结果各半时 H=1比特；九一开时 H≈0.469比特——九成把握意味着结果几乎已定，平均悬念大减。均匀分布每个结果同样可能，你无法押注任何一个，猜中前的悬念最大，这就是「均匀最不确定」的来源。条件变化：结果数增多，熵的上界 log₂n 随之增大，十面骰比硬币更不确定；分布完全集中在一个结果上时熵为0，毫无悬念。注意熵只描述分布本身，不评价结果好坏，也不承诺任何单次结果。
answers.v06: Deadlock: two or more processes each hold a resource and wait for one the other holds, so none can ever proceed. Small example: process A holds the printer and now requests the file lock; process B holds the file lock and requests the printer. Each waits for the other to release first; nothing is released, so both freeze forever. This only happens when four conditions hold at once: resources are exclusive, holders keep them while waiting for more, nothing can be forcibly taken away, and the waits form a circle. Break any one and deadlock becomes impossible — which is why the practical fix is simple: give all locks a global order and have every process acquire them in that order; then the circle cannot close. Alternatives: grab all resources at once, or time out and release what you hold. Costs: fixed ordering reduces parallelism, and timeouts need jitter or retries collide again.
answers.v07: 公共物品是人人都能用、且一人使用不妨碍他人的东西：路灯、国防、防洪堤、干净的空气。两个特征：非排他——无法把不付钱的人挡在外面；非竞争——多一人享用不减少别人的。麻烦由非排他引出：搭便车。路灯对你值100元，但不付钱它也照样亮，理性的选择就是等别人出钱；人人这样想，市场收不回成本，路灯就没人修——尽管所有人都受益。这正是路灯和国防由税收供给的原因：用强制分摊替代自愿付费。条件变化：一旦能排他，性质就变——收费电视对不付费者关屏，专利禁止未授权使用，市场就能收费供给，搭便车随之减弱。范围也重要：楼道照明人少、互相看得见，监督和情面能压住搭便车；人数越多越匿名，问题越重。
answers.v08: Little's law: L = λW. In a stable system, the average number of items inside (L) equals the arrival rate (λ) times the average time each item spends inside (W). Coffee shop: 10 customers arrive per minute, each stays 3 minutes — on average 30 people are inside. It holds for any queue shape, any service discipline, any distribution: it is bookkeeping about averages, not a claim about speed. Its power is measuring the unmeasurable — count throughput and lead time to get average inventory, or count inventory and throughput to get waiting time. The catch is stability: it requires steady state, where arrival rate equals departure rate. If customers arrive faster than the shop serves them, the queue grows without bound and L stops being a meaningful average. Also define the boundary once: 'in the system' must mean the same thing for all three numbers.
